mainEntity.name: How could I coordinate AI assistants to create and launch a digital product without losing quality?

acceptedAnswer.text: A useful digital-product workflow can connect audience research, opportunity evaluation, course or product outlining, lesson or presentation drafting, production support, sales copy, funnel preparation, and launch review. Keep the product owner responsible for accuracy, originality, teaching value, pricing, and final claims. Ask each assistant to return work in a format the next stage can use, such as an approved outline before lesson scripts or a verified offer brief before sales copy. Test the product with representative readers before investing heavily in promotion. Run My AI Biz’s examples specifically connect course planning, presentation development, lesson scripts, video support, and launch preparation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Link research, offer definition, outlining, lesson or presentation drafts, production support, sales copy, funnel preparation, and launch review. Require approval at each stage, verify claims, and test the product before promotion.
